summary.text: Lauren Arikan is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 7B in Harford County and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has served in the House since January 2019 and sits on the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Arikan studied English language and literature at the University of Baltimore from 2007 to 2009, according to her legislative biography.
She has operated Arikan Acres, a poultry and goat farm, since 2014, has owned Arikan Investments since 2016, and has served as director of public relations for Arikan Accounting and Tax since 2009.
Ballotpedia says she founded Birth Circle of Baltimore.

Her listed public service includes chairing the Love Maryland PAC from 2015 to 2018, serving on the board of Maryland Friends of Midwives from 2012 to 2014, and serving as vice president of the Victoria Russell Foundation since 2017.

Arikan was first elected to the House in 2018 and has served since January 9, 2019, first representing District 7 in Baltimore and Harford counties and, since January 11, 2023, District 7B in Harford County.
She has been a member of the Judiciary Committee since 2019, currently serves on its Civil, Criminal and Juvenile subcommittees, and was Deputy Minority Whip from 2019 to 2021.
In the 2022 Republican primary she defeated fellow incumbent Rick Impallaria and three other candidates, and she won the general election over Democrat Medford Campbell III.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026, and faces Democrat Candace Hart in the general election.
